finalists.label: Blastomycosis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of severe diffuse lympho-monocytic inflammation with minimal necrosis, angioinvasive microbial structures, and sparse hyphal mats with sporangial-type cells.

finalists.label: Invasive fungal infection
finalists.why: It has strong evidence of severe diffuse lympho-monocytic inflammation with minimal necrosis, angioinvasive microbial structures, and sparse hyphal mats with sporangial-type cells, with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of numerous thick-walled ovoid sporangia that stained strongly with PAS, GMS, and Giemsa, and thin-walled pauciseptate hyphae with minimal branching, specifically supports Blastomycosis over the more general Invasive fungal infection.
